home.offlineUnavailable: Offline · this view will load when you're back online

sync.paused: Saved on this device, it will sync when you're back online

voice.title: Dictate transaction
voice.ready: I'm listening, speak whenever you're ready
voice.noAmount: I didn't catch the amount · tap Edit to type it

denied.title: No microphone permission
denied.body: Turn it on from the lock next to the page address (Site settings → Microphone → Allow) and try again.

noMic.title: We couldn't find a microphone
noMic.body: Connect one or make sure no other app is using it.

noSpeech.title: I didn't hear you
noSpeech.body: Speak close to the microphone, in Spanish, for example: “{example}”.

network.title: Dictation needs internet
network.body: Your browser transcribes speech online. While offline you can type it instead; it syncs when you're back online.

unsupported.title: Your browser doesn't support dictation
unsupported.body: Try Chrome, Edge or Safari, or type it instead.

unknown.title: We couldn't hear you
unknown.body: Something went wrong with the microphone. Please try again.

receipt.title: Scan receipt
receipt.noAmount: Couldn't read the amount · tap Edit to type it
receipt.foreignCurrency: This receipt is in {currency}. It will be saved in your currency without conversion; check the amount.

notReceipt.title: This doesn't look like a receipt
notReceipt.body: Take a clear photo of a receipt, card slip or payment screenshot where the amount is visible.

invalidImage.title: We couldn't open the image
invalidImage.body: Try another photo or a JPG or PNG screenshot.

limited.title: Too many scans in a row
limited.body: Wait a minute and try again.

failed.title: We couldn't read the receipt
failed.body: Something went wrong processing the image. Try again or type it in.

offline.title: We couldn't read it offline
offline.body: Offline we can only read sharp receipts on your phone. Try a clearer photo or type it in; it syncs when you're back online.

steps.ocr: Reading the text on your phone…

method.qr: Read from the SUNAT QR code
method.ocr: Read on your phone, no AI

detail.label: Repeats
detail.stopFailed: We couldn't stop it. Try again.
detail.stopped: It won't repeat anymore. Past transactions are kept.
